whatIs.a: Novala is an all-in-one business management platform built for small and mid-size businesses. It brings together everything you need to run your business in a single connected system.
bullets: Payroll: Full compliance from statutory contributions to year-end tax forms
Accounting: Books, reconciliation, and financial reports in one place
Invoicing: Send, track, and get paid faster
Workforce: Scheduling, time tracking, and team management
Vela AI: Ask questions in plain English and get answers from your business data

easyToLearn.a: Absolutely. Novala is designed for business owners, not accountants. The platform provides a guided experience from day one with everything set up to help you succeed.
bullets: Guided setup wizard walks you through connecting your bank, adding employees, and creating your first invoice
Vela AI assistant answers questions in plain English using your business data
Interactive tutorials and tooltips throughout the app
Live support via chat or email during business hours

cost.a: Pricing is straightforward and scales with your business. There are no long-term contracts and you can start with a free trial to see the value first.
bullets: Solo plan for freelancers and single-person businesses
Small business plan for teams up to 25 employees
Growth plan for teams up to 100 employees
Enterprise plan for larger teams with custom needs
All plans include Vela AI, unlimited invoices, and responsive support

payroll.a: Yes. Novala handles payroll from setup to filing with full tax compliance built in. Federal and provincial calculations are automatic and always up to date with tax rate changes.
bullets: Automatic CPP, EI, and income tax calculations for all provinces
T4, T4A, and ROE generation with one-click filing
Direct deposit for employees and contractors
Payroll tax remittances on time, every time
Full payroll history and audit trail

expenses.q: Can Novala track my business expenses?
expenses.a: Yes. Novala connects to your business bank accounts to automatically import and categorize transactions. Manual entry is optional, not required.
bullets: Automatic bank feed connection with 200+ major financial institutions
Snap photos of receipts with your phone to attach to transactions
Custom categories and rules for automatic sorting
Real-time reporting on where your money goes
Tag expenses to projects or clients for detailed profitability

businessSize.q: What size businesses is Novala for?
businessSize.a: Novala serves businesses of every size, from solo freelancers to mid-market operations. The platform scales with you as you grow.
bullets: Solo entrepreneurs and freelancers
Small businesses (2 to 49 employees)
Mid-size businesses (50 to 500 employees)
Larger organizations with custom needs
Both service and product-based businesses

importData.q: Can I import data from QuickBooks or another accounting tool?
importData.a: Yes. Novala provides guided import from all major accounting platforms. Your data migrates over in a few clicks, not weeks.
bullets: QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop
Xero, FreshBooks, Wave, and Sage
Bank statements in CSV or OFX format
Chart of accounts, customers, vendors, and open balances
Historical transactions preserved for reporting

mobile.a: Yes. The Novala web app is fully responsive and works on any smartphone or tablet browser. A dedicated mobile app is coming for employees.
bullets: Full web app works on any mobile browser
Approve payroll and send invoices from your phone
Snap receipts on the go with camera integration
Employee mobile app coming for iOS and Android
Push notifications for approvals and reminders

security.a: Absolutely. Security is a first-class concern at Novala. Your data is protected by bank-level encryption and stored only in secure global data centers.
bullets: Bank-level 256-bit SSL encryption for all data in transit
AES-256 encryption at rest with automated backups
SOC 2 compliant secure global data centers
Two-factor authentication for all users
Never share your information with third parties

needAccountant.q: Do I need an accountant to use Novala?
needAccountant.a: No. Novala is designed for business owners without accounting expertise. That said, you can invite your accountant to collaborate directly in the platform if you have one.
bullets: Guided workflows explain every step in plain English
Vela AI answers accounting questions using your data
Accountant collaboration built in with role-based access
Year-end and tax packages generated automatically
Many customers use Novala independently and only check with their accountant at tax time

velaChat.greeting: Hi! I am Vela. I can help you learn about Novala and how it can help your business. What would you like to know?

whatIsNovala.question: What is Novala?
whatIsNovala.response: Novala is an all-in-one business management platform for small and mid-size businesses. We handle payroll, accounting, invoicing, workforce management, and more, all compliance-ready. One platform for everything your business needs.

howDoesVelaWork.question: How does Vela work?
howDoesVelaWork.response: Once you sign up, I become your business assistant powered by your own data. Ask me anything about your payroll, accounting, invoices, or team, and I answer in plain English with insights from your actual business data.

features.question: What features are included?
features.response: Novala includes Payroll (compliance-ready), Accounting, Invoicing, Time Tracking, Reporting, Bank Feeds, Receipt Scanning, Workforce Management, and me (Vela). Everything you need to run your business, all in one platform.

pricing.question: How much does Novala cost?
pricing.response: We offer a free 30-day trial with no credit card required. Plans are competitive for growing businesses. Click Plans and pricing above to see current options.

velaChat.security: Novala uses bank-level encryption (256-bit SSL), stores your data in secure global data centers, and follows SOC 2 compliance standards. Your business data is safe with us.
velaChat.support: We offer email support to all users, with priority support for paid plans. Sign up for a free 30-day trial and you will have full access to our support team.
velaChat.compliance: Yes! Novala is fully compliant. We handle employment records and tax forms, sales tax, and all tax requirements automatically. Your filings are always up to date.
velaChat.defaultResponse: Great question! For a detailed answer, sign up for a free 30-day trial and I can help you explore all of Novala once you are inside.
